ops.en: public-health conditions and systems that protect health through cleanliness, safe water, waste and sewage disposal, and hygiene
ops.cn: 环境卫生与公共卫生设施；通过清洁、安全用水、垃圾和污水处理等保护健康的条件与系统

ops.en: the process of making something sanitary, clean, or free from harmful microorganisms
ops.cn: 卫生处理；使某物达到清洁、无有害微生物的状态

ops.en: the fluid that circulates through a plant, carrying water, minerals, sugars, and other substances
ops.cn: 树液；植物体内运输水、矿物质、糖等物质的液体

ops.en: to gradually weaken, exhaust, or drain someone's strength, confidence, energy, or resources
ops.cn: 逐渐削弱；耗尽某人的体力、信心、精力或资源

ops.note: Historical/specialist sense: dig a sap or tunnel beneath a defensive position.

ops.en: sharp, ironic, or cutting language used to mock, wound, criticize, or express contempt
ops.cn: 讽刺；挖苦；用尖刻或反讽语言嘲弄、伤害、批评或表达轻蔑

boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same lexeme.

ops.en: to enjoy, appreciate, or experience something fully and deliberately, including a taste, feeling, or moment
ops.cn: 细细品味；充分欣赏或享受味道、感受、时刻等

ops.note: Also: to give flavor or a characteristic taste to something.

ops.meaning_cn: 细细体会、充分珍惜某个时刻或经历

boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same adjective/noun lexeme.

ops.en: salty, spicy, or otherwise not sweet; also appetizing in smell or taste
ops.cn: 咸香的；辛香的；非甜味的；味道或气味诱人的

ops.note: Botanical noun: a Mediterranean aromatic shrub/herb.

ops.value: Savory/savoury is the ordinary food adjective. The negative moral adjective is normally unsavory/unsavoury; do not infer a positive moral meaning from savory.

ops.en: too small, meager, or insufficient in amount, size, or coverage
ops.cn: 不足的；少量的；覆盖或数量过少的

ops.en: to lift, remove, or gather something with a scoop or a similar curved movement
ops.cn: 舀起；铲起；用勺状工具或类似动作取出

ops.en: an exclusive news story obtained and published before competitors
ops.cn: 独家新闻；抢先获得并发布的新闻

ops.en: to obtain, collect, or pick something or someone up quickly
ops.cn: 迅速取得、收集或接走某人/某物

ops.en: to make or utter a harsh, high-pitched cry, shriek, or scraping sound
ops.cn: 尖叫；发出刺耳的高音或摩擦声

ops.en: a harsh, high-pitched cry, shriek, or scraping sound
ops.cn: 尖厉刺耳的叫声或摩擦声

ops.en: to write or draw quickly, carelessly, or untidily
ops.cn: 潦草地写；随手乱画；匆忙草写

ops.en: careless, untidy, or hard-to-read handwriting
ops.cn: 潦草的字迹；难辨认的草写

ops.en: a quick, careless, or aimless drawing or doodle
ops.cn: 随手涂鸦；乱画

ops.en: a moral hesitation or uneasy feeling about whether an action is right
ops.cn: 道德顾虑；因担心某行为不妥而产生的犹豫

ops.en: a moral or ethical principle that prevents or restrains an action
ops.cn: 道德原则；阻止或约束某种行为的伦理顾忌

ops.en: extremely careful, thorough, and exact about details, accuracy, or doing something correctly
ops.cn: 一丝不苟的；极其仔细严谨的；十分注重准确性的

ops.en: principled, conscientious, and careful to act according to what is right
ops.cn: 有原则的；谨慎守德的；按良知和正确原则行事的

boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same verb.

ops.en: to examine something very closely and critically, especially for detail, accuracy, or possible problems
ops.cn: 仔细审查；严密检查；为发现细节、准确性或问题而认真查看

ops.en: to move or run swiftly, especially driven along by strong wind
ops.cn: 疾驰；快速移动，尤指被强风推动着前进

ops.en: swift movement, especially before or under a strong wind
ops.cn: 疾行；尤指在强风中快速移动

ops.value: Low-value tanning material historically associated with scud must remain reference-only and must not enter modern learner Core.

ops.en: a substance or mixture, such as salt, herbs, or spices, added to food to improve or change its flavor
ops.cn: 调味料；为改善或改变食物味道而加入的盐、香草、香料等物质或混合物

ops.en: the act or process of adding flavoring to food
ops.cn: 调味；给食物添加调味料的过程

ops.en: the biological process by which a cell, gland, or organ produces and releases a substance
ops.cn: 分泌；细胞、腺体或器官产生并释放物质的生物过程

ops.en: a substance produced and released by a cell, gland, or organ
ops.cn: 分泌物；由细胞、腺体或器官产生并释放的物质

ops.value: Secretion is biological production/release and its product. Do not import the unrelated secrete = hide/conceal sense.

ops.en: a subgroup within a larger movement, community, or tradition distinguished by particular beliefs or practices, especially a religious group
ops.cn: 派别；宗派；在较大运动、群体或传统中因特定信念或做法而形成的分支，尤指宗教派别

ops.en: not religious or spiritual; relating to ordinary worldly, civil, or public life rather than religion
ops.cn: 世俗的；非宗教的；与普通社会、公民或公共生活而非宗教事务有关的

ops.note: Doctrine-related use is narrower than the ordinary adjective secular and should not organize learner Core.
Specialist church use: secular clergy are not bound by monastic vows.

ops.en: calm, dignified, quiet, and unhurried in manner, style, or pace
ops.cn: 沉着安静的；庄重的；从容不迫的

ops.en: to calm or make someone drowsy by giving a sedative drug
ops.cn: 给镇静剂；用药物使镇静或困倦

ops.en: to be extremely angry, agitated, or full of intense emotion while often trying not to show it
ops.cn: 怒火中烧；内心极度愤怒或激动，常强忍不发

ops.en: to boil vigorously
ops.cn: 沸腾；剧烈翻滚

ops.en: relating to, caused by, or measured as earthquakes or vibrations of the earth
ops.cn: 地震的；地震引起的；与地壳震动有关的

ops.en: figurative: enormous, far-reaching, or fundamental in impact or change
ops.cn: （比喻）影响巨大的；根本性的；具有深远变化的

ops.meaning_cn: 巨大的、根本性的转变/变化

ops.en: an outward appearance or impression, or a small degree or trace of a quality or condition
ops.cn: 表象；外观；某种品质或状态的一点迹象、些许程度

ops.meaning_cn: 一点……的样子；某种事物的表面迹象或少量程度

ops.en: causing great excitement, shock, or public interest, often in an attention-grabbing or exaggerated way
ops.cn: 轰动的；耸人听闻的；引起强烈震惊或公众关注的

ops.en: informal: extremely good, impressive, or exciting
ops.cn: （非正式）极好的；令人印象深刻的；精彩的

ops.note: Specialist sense relating to sensation or sensory processes.

ops.en: relating to or gratifying the senses, especially in an aesthetically rich, pleasing, or luxurious way
ops.cn: 感官享受的；诉诸感官且具有审美、愉悦或丰润质感的

ops.value: Sensuous typically emphasizes aesthetic sensory experience; sensual more often emphasizes physical or sexual pleasure. Keep the semantic/register spaces distinct.

ops.en: calm, peaceful, and untroubled in mood, appearance, scene, or atmosphere
ops.cn: 宁静的；平和的；安详无忧的

ops.en: clear, calm, and fine, especially of weather or sky
ops.cn: 晴朗宁静的；尤指天气或天空清澈平静

ops.en: the quality or state of being calm, peaceful, composed, and untroubled
ops.cn: 宁静；平和；沉着安定的状态或品质

ops.en: freedom from excessive mental stress, agitation, or anxiety
ops.cn: 心境安宁；没有过度压力、躁动或焦虑的状态

ops.en: to cut or divide something completely, or to break a connection, relationship, or association
ops.cn: 切断；割断；使完全分离；断绝联系、关系或关联

ops.en: a restraint, especially a metal fastening used to confine a prisoner's wrists or ankles
ops.cn: 镣铐；束缚装置，尤指限制囚犯手腕或脚踝的金属铐具

ops.en: to restrain or fasten someone with shackles
ops.cn: 给……戴上镣铐；用铐具束缚

ops.en: figurative: to severely restrict someone's freedom, action, growth, or ability
ops.cn: （比喻）严重束缚、限制自由、行动、发展或能力

ops.en: dishonest, evasive, suspicious, or trying to avoid being direct or truthful
ops.cn: 不诚实的；躲躲闪闪的；可疑的；故意回避直说的

ops.en: changing position, direction, or character repeatedly
ops.cn: 不断改变位置、方向或性质的

ops.en: a thin strip, torn piece, or small fragment cut or ripped from something
ops.cn: 碎条；碎片；从某物上撕下或切下的细条、小片

ops.en: to tear or cut something into thin strips or small fragments
ops.cn: 撕碎；切成细条或小碎片

ops.en: figurative: a very small amount or trace of something
ops.cn: （比喻）一点；一丝；极少量

ops.en: to shrink, wither, wrinkle, or become smaller and drier, especially through loss of moisture
ops.cn: 枯萎；皱缩；因失水而变小、变干、起皱

ops.value: Low-value historical residue translated as 使束手无策 is not part of modern shrivel Core and remains reference-only.

ops.en: suggesting evil, danger, threat, or harmful intent
ops.cn: 邪恶的；阴险的；不祥的；暗示危险或恶意的

ops.en: heraldry: on or toward the bearer's left side
ops.cn: （纹章学）位于持盾者左侧的
